facts.fact: The Minister of Trade and Industry launched Malawi's National Single Window on 20 May 2025, live first for the trade ministry with seven MDAs at go-live and 22 agencies planned by September 2025, and SATCP's project manager says it integrates with the Malawi Revenue Authority's ASYCUDA World system.
The Malawi Revenue Authority says it is upgrading its customs management system from ASYCUDA World 4.3.3 to 4.4, with migration scheduled for 11 January 2025.
The Malawi Revenue Authority says it supports clearing agents, importers and exporters on its ASYCUDA World 4.3.3 system at all customs stations across the country.
Since February 2025 Kalondola has been linked to Asycuda, described as the customs clearance system, so imports in specified categories must meet stamp requirements at entry points.

UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme says ASYCUDAWorld 4.3.3 was rolled out by the Malawi Revenue Authority in Blantyre on 20 October 2023, and MRA's Dedza station manager says it is used to process imports and exports and to declare goods.

The SARS-MRA arrangement, applicable on signature on 30 July 2026, provides for automatic exchange of customs declaration and transit data between the two authorities' automated customs systems, using a unique consignment reference.

facts.fact: The Nation reports the Malawi Revenue Authority's upgraded ASYCUDA World processes import and export declarations and uses risk profiles to route them at Mchinji and Kamuzu International Airport.
TradeMark Africa reports the Malawi Revenue Authority customs system processes export and import declarations, with the enhanced CCEDE live with the neighbouring authority since November 2025.

facts.fact: SATCP says the Malawi Revenue Authority is upgrading, testing and piloting ASYCUDA World from version 4.3.3 to 4.4.0, to complete by September 2025, with a scanner integration with ASYCUDA operational.

note: The single window had only a pilot launch on 19 May 2025 and is work in progress; the tripartite customs data exchange is planned from June 2025.
